digest.component_or_area: rebar MCP server grounding_info schema initialization
propositions: MCP v1 defines generic Settings before FastMCP under postponed annotations, leaving Settings.model_fields["lifespan"] unresolved as a ForwardRef that pydantic-settings 2.15 flags with IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning on first construction
Public build_server() aborts when IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning is promoted to an error because Settings metadata remains incomplete until after first FastMCP initialization
Calling Settings.model_rebuild() at the MCP import boundary in build_server() resolves the forward reference and eliminates the warning without suppressing or downgrading dependencies
Fresh-process construction of FastMCP via build_server() must succeed and emit no warning when IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning is treated as an error
